lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Arrive and speak with the host
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: give the reservation name, handle a wait, and discuss seating
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Arrive early, confirm the booking, and decide whether to wait at the bar.
lessons.title: Arrive, Confirm, and Wait
lessons.objective: Give the reservation name on arrival, ask how long the table will take, choose where to wait, and ask about a window seat.
lessons.focus: スミスの名前で予約しています identifies the booking name. まだ席の準備ができていません reports that the table is not ready; あと十五分ほど gives an approximate wait. バーで待ってもいいですか asks permission to wait at the bar, while 窓際の席は空いていますか asks about a seating preference. ～で marks the place where waiting happens; ～に marks the place where a table is located.
lessons.scene: Sam and a companion arrive early at a restaurant. The host finds their booking but asks them to wait fifteen minutes, so they ask to wait at the bar and check for a window seat.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約はございますか。
reader.en: Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: はい。スミスの名前で二名、午後八時に予約しています。
reader.en: Yes. I have a reservation for two at 8:00 p.m. under the name Smith.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: 一覧を確認します。少々お待ちください。
reader.en: I will check the list. Please wait a moment.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: ご予約がございます。席の準備がまだできていません。
reader.en: I found your reservation. The table is not ready yet.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 待ち時間はどのくらいですか。
reader.en: How long is the wait?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: あと十五分ほどです。番号札をお渡しします。
reader.en: About fifteen more minutes. I will give you a number.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: バーで待ってもいいですか。
reader.en: May we wait at the bar?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: はい。バーでお待ちいただけます。
reader.en: Yes. You may wait at the bar.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 窓際の席は空いていますか。
reader.en: Is a window seat available?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: 空いたらご案内します。お飲み物をどうぞ。
reader.en: If one opens up, I will show you there. Please enjoy a drink.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: ask about drinks, nonalcoholic choices, and included snacks
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Join the local pre-dinner custom and ask how it works.
lessons.title: Ask About Pre-Dinner Drinks
lessons.objective: Ask what drinks are offered before dinner, choose a nonalcoholic option, and check whether a small snack comes with a drink.
lessons.focus: 食前酒 is an alcoholic aperitif; 食前の飲み物 is the broader phrase for a pre-dinner drink. アルコールなしの飲み物 asks for a nonalcoholic choice. 飲み物のメニューを見せていただけますか requests the drink menu politely. おつまみは飲み物に付いていますか asks whether a snack comes with the drink. Each restaurant's service may differ, so ask what is offered here.
lessons.scene: Before dinner, Mika asks a server how pre-dinner drinks work at this restaurant. The server offers sparkling water, juice, and wine and explains that olives come with the drinks.
